recommendations.title: Civil Services Officer
recommendations.summary: Work in public administration, governance and public service.
recommendations.route: Complete a recognised bachelor’s degree and verify the current UPSC or State PSC eligibility and exam notices.

recommendations.title: Journalist
recommendations.summary: Research, verify and communicate stories across print, broadcast and digital media.
recommendations.route: Explore journalism, media, communication or a subject specialisation; build reporting and writing experience.

recommendations.title: Software Developer
recommendations.summary: Build applications, websites and digital tools that solve real problems.
recommendations.route: Explore computer science, information technology or related degree and diploma routes; check each institution’s current eligibility.

recommendations.title: Entrepreneur
recommendations.summary: Develop a useful idea into a product, service or organisation.
recommendations.route: There is no single degree route. Build knowledge in a domain, business fundamentals and practical projects.

recommendations.title: Law & Justice
recommendations.summary: Explore legal practice, research, advocacy, policy and justice-related work.
recommendations.route: Compare integrated law programmes after Class 12 with other recognised law routes; verify current admissions and licensing rules.
